scope: One-step diagnostic of saved first blocks under the broader fixed-dual-anchor theorem.

definitions.selection: All guillotine runs of complete-boundary+verified-strip ending at their first block.
definitions.recognition: Complete rectangular side graph, exterior and one uncut old universal anchor, residual linear forest; no band requirement.
definitions.canonical_naming: Keep exterior 1 and unique anchor's old name; alternate other two names from lexicographically smaller endpoint of each path.
definitions.multiplicity: Runs are seed-and-inheritance-policy states, not necessarily distinct geometric maps.
definitions.independence: Rectangle adjacency is independently derived; Node rebuilds geometry/probes edge shores; Python independently rebuilds shore orbits from rotations.

limits: The main v2 experiment and its algorithm are unchanged.
One-step certificates do not claim successful completion of any remaining construction history.
Canonical restart may change the requested inherited side and any non-anchor old names; no minimum-change claim.
Failure of recognition is not a proof that a four-name repair is impossible.
Node and Python auditing reuse established geometry/rotation modules, not an independently reimplemented floating-point planarizer.
No coloring enumeration, trial assignment, backtracking, or general four-color solver produces these certificates.
